name: Aragaki Chiyoko
source:
Although she is not the most beautiful, she has a pretty face and a body men absolutely love. She hates to show it off and always has a low-key atmosphere, so few men know of her charms.

Her husband, Satoshi Aragaki, is the floor manager of the supermarket where she works. Her husband is a playboy who does not spend his money on family, simply because he does not care about them.

Chiyoko is viewed as a convenient woman by her husband, and is currently suffering financial insecurity because he forcibly takes her wages, and spends it on other women. This forces her to steal from the store to support her beloved son.

When the protagonist discovers this, he uses this information against her. She endures the humiliating acts by the protagonist in order to protect her son and her abusive husband's position in the super market.

Chiyoko, who has never had a strong sexual desire, begins to develop her prowess as a woman.

Hobby: Patchwork

"I beg you... Please put some money into the household"

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20221005051345/https://www.guilty-soft.com/gg33/top_off.html]official site[/url]]
